name: Poison Ivy
desc: Poison Ivy (Toxicodendron rydbergii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 47 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Toxicodendron rydbergii, the western poison ivy, is a species of Toxicodendron in the cashew family native to North America. As a poison ivy, it can cause urushiol-induced contact dermatitis.
